topics.description: The conflict between Trump and Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell has intensified amid a federal investigation. Trump has threatened to fire Powell if he doesn't leave office. This conflict has significant implications for the US economy and the Federal Reserve's independence.

There have been recent developments in Medicaid fraud investigations, including a new task force established to root out fraud and a case of a Lancaster County employee obstructing a federal investigation into an Iranian national illegally in the US.
